subject: Request: short sprint credit patch while PO processes
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short sprint credit patch while PO processes

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Novamed is a great fit for our private deployment story and I want to keep your engineers able to run one last smoke test while procurement finishes the PO.

Quick ask: would Novamed be open to a 72-hour sprint credit patch (approx. 150k tokens / sandbox access) that keeps your team live until the PO clears? We typically do a small one-off credit for customers in procurement limbo to avoid losing evaluation momentum.

If helpful, I attached a draft PO you mentioned and a quick screenshot of the portal error you hit this morning. We can do the patch under the following terms:
- One-time credit valid for 72 hours
- Activation on receipt of a purchase order number (we’ll reference it in our billing)
- No additional billing until PO is processed; credits expire if PO is not issued within 7 days

If procurement needs a signature or a short invoice to attach to the PO, I can send that from our finance team — looping Marissa and Priyom for quick internal approval.

Next steps: if procurement confirms the PO is in flight, reply-all with the PO# and I’ll authorize the patch immediately.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: Novamed_PO_Draft.pdf (application/pdf), screenshot-portal-err.png (image/png)

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick follow.

I'm forwarding this to procurement — procurement@novamed.com — who are handling the PO. The PO is drafted but our legal team is clarifying one small clause; procurement expects the PO to be routed by EOD Thursday (05/06).

We definitely want to avoid the disruption to the eval. Procurement, can you confirm if Novamed can accept a short-term access patch in the meantime and whether you need anything else from Redwood (invoice, signature, billing contact)?

Sara Liu
Director of ML Systems 
Novamed
